tracked_requirement_count.label: Tracked requirements
tracked_requirement_count.short_help: Registry rows in scope on the Requirements page (tracked DOCUMENT/JOB items, excluding not-applicable lifecycle).

score_tracked_requirement_count.label: Score-tracked obligations
score_tracked_requirement_count.short_help: Obligations counted in the compliance score projection after runtime filtering and portal visibility.

compliant_requirement_count.label: Valid for scoring
compliant_requirement_count.short_help: Rows with projected compliance status COMPLIANT or VALID (score KPI bucket).

satisfied_requirement_count.label: Recorded on file (unverified)
satisfied_requirement_count.short_help: Recorded evidence on file — not yet fully verified by the platform.

verified_requirement_count.label: Lifecycle verified
verified_requirement_count.short_help: Client lifecycle VERIFIED — platform-accepted evidence state.

missing_document_count.label: Missing document (score view)
missing_document_count.short_help: Score projection: pending/missing rows that still count as missing required evidence (satisfied-without-doc excluded).

expiring_requirement_count.label: Renewal approaching (score view)
expiring_requirement_count.short_help: Obligations with renewal or expiry approaching in the score-tracked set.

self_recorded_count.label: Self-recorded assurance
self_recorded_count.short_help: Self-recorded or on-file assurance without platform verification.

reporting_semantics.convergence_note: score_tracked_requirement_count and compliant_requirement_count align with dashboard compliance-score stats when the same enrich+projection pipeline is used.
